meta.title: Battle Dialogue · One Leaves
meta.description: Parallel tracks of light form the one-and-only star.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>—Initiating Judgement Mode</color>
units.displayText: —Initiating Judgement Mode

spans.text: —Initiating Judgement Mode

units.rawText: Until a hand lands on his wrist, whereupon he moves.
units.displayText: Until a hand lands on his wrist, whereupon he moves.

spans.text: Until a hand lands on his wrist, whereupon he moves.

units.rawText: My neural cloud... Will probably remain within your body forever.
units.displayText: My neural cloud... Will probably remain within your body forever.

spans.text: My neural cloud... Will probably remain within your body forever.

units.rawText: But that's fine. That way, <cmdr> and I will be able to witness our end.
units.displayText: But that's fine. That way, {교수} and I will be able to witness our end.

spans.text: But that's fine. That way,
and I will be able to witness our end.

units.rawText: <size=28>...This should not be your ending.</size>
units.displayText: ...This should not be your ending.

spans.text: ...This should not be your ending.

units.rawText: Eosphorus whispers quietly before closing his eyes again.
units.displayText: Eosphorus whispers quietly before closing his eyes again.

spans.text: Eosphorus whispers quietly before closing his eyes again.

units.rawText: The light shifts and gathers where he cannot see, and then it moves.
units.displayText: The light shifts and gathers where he cannot see, and then it moves.

spans.text: The light shifts and gathers where he cannot see, and then it moves.

units.rawText: Eosphorus feels the weight in his hand lighten.
units.displayText: Eosphorus feels the weight in his hand lighten.

spans.text: Eosphorus feels the weight in his hand lighten.

units.rawText: Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Eosphorus...

spans.text: Eosphorus...

units.rawText: Thank you for bringing us here.
units.displayText: Thank you for bringing us here.

spans.text: Thank you for bringing us here.

units.rawText: Eosphorus presses his lips shut. He looks more miserable than Eos holding back her trembling as she gasps for breath.
units.displayText: Eosphorus presses his lips shut. He looks more miserable than Eos holding back her trembling as she gasps for breath.

spans.text: Eosphorus presses his lips shut. He looks more miserable than Eos holding back her trembling as she gasps for breath.

units.rawText: Back then, when all the stars in the universe sang as one...
units.displayText: Back then, when all the stars in the universe sang as one...

spans.text: Back then, when all the stars in the universe sang as one...

units.rawText: When even the heavens and the twinkling of the stars between the clouds rejoiced...
units.displayText: When even the heavens and the twinkling of the stars between the clouds rejoiced...

spans.text: When even the heavens and the twinkling of the stars between the clouds rejoiced...

units.rawText: The stars cast their eyes down...
units.displayText: The stars cast their eyes down...

spans.text: The stars cast their eyes down...

units.rawText: And there found light.
units.displayText: And there found light.

spans.text: And there found light.

units.rawText: Eosphorus can no longer feel any weight on his hand.
units.displayText: Eosphorus can no longer feel any weight on his hand.

spans.text: Eosphorus can no longer feel any weight on his hand.

units.rawText: Eos' breath has changed as well. It seems to be drawing away and growing faint, but at the same time it feels more real than ever, as though it has never left.
units.displayText: Eos' breath has changed as well. It seems to be drawing away and growing faint, but at the same time it feels more real than ever, as though it has never left.

spans.text: Eos' breath has changed as well. It seems to be drawing away and growing faint, but at the same time it feels more real than ever, as though it has never left.

units.rawText: So close, yet so far, drifting just out of reach.
units.displayText: So close, yet so far, drifting just out of reach.

spans.text: So close, yet so far, drifting just out of reach.

units.rawText: The stars and light accompany annihilation.
units.displayText: The stars and light accompany annihilation.

spans.text: The stars and light accompany annihilation.

units.rawText: Together, they become the most elementary particles of the universe.
units.displayText: Together, they become the most elementary particles of the universe.

spans.text: Together, they become the most elementary particles of the universe.

units.rawText: Something has fallen asleep, lonelier than the heavens and slower than time.
units.displayText: Something has fallen asleep, lonelier than the heavens and slower than time.

spans.text: Something has fallen asleep, lonelier than the heavens and slower than time.

units.rawText: Something has awakened, brighter than the stars, more dazzling than light.
units.displayText: Something has awakened, brighter than the stars, more dazzling than light.

spans.text: Something has awakened, brighter than the stars, more dazzling than light.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>Neural Cloud Fusion Protocol: Host: Eosphorus—Now combining...</color>
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Fusion Protocol: Host: Eosphorus—Now combining...

spans.text: Neural Cloud Fusion Protocol: Host: Eosphorus—Now combining...

units.rawText: Eosphorus slowly opens his eyes and silently listens to the series of notifications going off throughout his body.
units.displayText: Eosphorus slowly opens his eyes and silently listens to the series of notifications going off throughout his body.

spans.text: Eosphorus slowly opens his eyes and silently listens to the series of notifications going off throughout his body.
